questions.questionText: How many Surahs are in the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: The Quran contains 114 Surahs.

questions.questionText: Which Surah opens the Quran?
questions.explanation: Al-Fatihah is first in the standard arrangement.

questions.questionText: Which is the longest Surah?
questions.explanation: Al-Baqarah contains 286 verses.

questions.questionText: How many Surahs has the fewest number of verses?
questions.explanation: Four Surahs have 3 verses; Al-Kawthar, Al-Ikhlas, An-Nasr & Al-Asr.

questions.questionText: How many Juz are in the commonly used division?
questions.explanation: The Quran is conventionally divided into 30 Juz.

questions.questionText: Which Surah is known as Umm al-Kitab?
questions.explanation: Al-Fatihah is known as Umm al-Kitab, meaning The Mother of the Book.

questions.questionText: Which Surah does not begin with Bismillah?
questions.explanation: At-Tawbah is the only Surah without the basmalah at its beginning.

questions.questionText: Where is Ayat al-Kursi found?
questions.explanation: Ayat al-Kursi is verse 255 of Al-Baqarah.

questions.questionText: What is the reference for Ayat al-Kursi?
questions.explanation: Ayat al-Kursi is Al-Baqarah 2:255.

questions.questionText: Which Surah is named after Mary, mother of Prophet Isa عليه السلام?
questions.explanation: Surah Maryam is named after Mary.

questions.questionText: Which Surah means 'The Cow'?
questions.explanation: Al-Baqarah means The Cow.

questions.questionText: Which Surah presents the story of Prophet Yusuf in a continuous narrative?
questions.explanation: Surah Yusuf relates the account of Prophet Yusuf.

questions.questionText: Which Surah is named after the bee?
questions.explanation: An-Nahl means The Bee.

questions.questionText: Which Surah is named after the Elephant?
questions.explanation: Al-fil means The Elephant.

questions.questionText: Which Surah is named after the ant?
questions.explanation: An-Naml means The Ant.

questions.questionText: Which Surah is named after the spider?
questions.explanation: Al-Ankabut means The Spider.

questions.questionText: Where did the first revelation come to Prophet Muhammad?
questions.explanation: The first revelation came while he was in the Cave of Hira.

questions.questionText: Which verses are identified as the first revelation?
questions.explanation: The opening five verses of Surah Al-Alaq are identified in the authentic narration.

questions.questionText: Which angel conveyed the Quranic revelation?
questions.explanation: Jibril عليه السلام conveyed revelation to Prophet Muhammad .

questions.questionText: Which prophet did Allah compared to Prophet Adam (عليه السلام) in terms of creation?
questions.explanation: In Surah Aal-e-Imran (3:59), Allah states that the example of Isa (عليه السلام) is like that of Adam (عليه السلام). Allah created Adam from dust and then said, 'Be,' and he was.

questions.questionText: According to the Quran, which prophet was given the ability to understand the speech of birds?
questions.explanation: Prophet Sulayman (عليه السلام) was taught the language of birds, as mentioned in Surah An-Naml (27:16).

questions.questionText: Which prophet was given the ability to interpret dreams by Allah?
questions.explanation: Prophet Yusuf (عليه السلام) was taught the interpretation of dreams, as mentioned in Surah Yusuf (12:6).

questions.questionText: Which Surah mentions the incident of the two sons of Adam?
questions.explanation: The story of the two sons of Adam (Habeel and Qabeel), one of whom killed the other, is mentioned in Surah Al-Ma'idah (5:27–31).

questions.questionText: Which prophet was swallowed by a great fish after leaving his people?
questions.explanation: Prophet Yunus (عليه السلام) was swallowed by a fish and called upon Allah from the darkness. His supplication is mentioned in Surah Al-Anbiya (21:87).

questions.questionText: Which prophet was thrown into a fire by his people, but Allah made it cool and safe for him?
questions.explanation: Prophet Ibrahim (عليه السلام) was thrown into the fire, but Allah commanded it to be cool and safe for him, as stated in Surah Al-Anbiya (21:69).

questions.questionText: What did Prophet Yusuf's brothers do to him when he was young?
questions.explanation: His brothers threw him into a well, as described in Surah Yusuf (12:15).

options.text: They abandoned him in a desert
They threw him into a well
They sold him to a king
They left him in a forest

questions.questionText: What did Prophet Musa (عليه السلام) throw down that became a snake?
questions.explanation: His staff turned into a clear snake by Allah's command, as described in Surah Al-A'raf (7:107).

questions.questionText: Which prophet was tested with severe illness and loss, then Allah restored his health and blessings?
questions.explanation: Prophet Ayyub (عليه السلام) endured severe hardship and called upon Allah, who removed his suffering and restored his family and blessings. See Surah Al-Anbiya (21:83–84).

questions.questionText: Which Surah refers to Laylat al-Qadr?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Qadr describes the Night of Decree.

questions.questionText: Which prophet is mentioned most frequently by name in the Quran?
questions.explanation: Prophet Musa عليه السلام is mentioned most frequently by name.

questions.questionText: What happened to Prophet Yaqub (عليه السلام) after he received the news of Yusuf's disappearance?
questions.explanation: Prophet Yaqub (عليه السلام) grieved deeply and his eyes turned white from sorrow, as mentioned in Surah Yusuf (12:84).

options.text: He lost his ability to walk

questions.questionText: Which prophet's mother was instructed by Allah to place him in a chest and cast it into the river?
questions.explanation: The mother of Prophet Musa (عليه السلام) received this instruction, as narrated in Surah Taha (20:38–39) and Surah Al-Qasas (28:7).

questions.questionText: The Quran contains 8 Manaazil.
questions.explanation: The Quran contains 7 Manaazil.

questions.questionText: In terms of verses, Aal-e-Imran is the second longest surah in the Quran (200 verses) after surah Al-Baqarah.
questions.explanation: Ash-Shu'ra is the 2nd longest with 227 verses, followed by Al-A'raaf (206) and then Aal-e-Imran.

questions.questionText: Al-Kawthar has five verses.
questions.explanation: Al-Kawthar has three verses.

questions.questionText: The commonly used division of the Quran has 30 Juz.
questions.explanation: The standard recitation division contains 30 Juz.

questions.questionText: At-Tawbah begins with Bismillah al-Rahman al-Rahim.
questions.explanation: At-Tawbah is the only Surah that does not begin with the basmalah.

questions.questionText: Ayat al-Kursi is in Surah Al-Baqarah.
questions.explanation: It is on the 1st page of 3rd Juz.

questions.questionText: Bismillahi ar-Rehman-ir-Rahim is mentioned 114 times in the Quran.
questions.explanation: Once in between Surah An-Naml, and once prior to each surah except At-Tawbah.

questions.questionText: The Quran was revealed to Prophet Musa عليه السلام.
questions.explanation: The Quran was revealed to Prophet Muhammad; Musa received the Tawrah.

questions.questionText: Surah Maryam is named after Mary, mother of Prophet Isa عليه السلام.
questions.explanation: The Surah is named Maryam.

questions.questionText: Every Surah has the same number of verses.
questions.explanation: Surah lengths vary considerably.

questions.questionText: Al-Asr is the shortest surah in the Quran, by word & letter count.
questions.explanation: Although several Surahs have three verses, Al-Kawthar is the shortest by word and letter count.
